Wx Update, E Caribbean, Mon15, 8am

TROPICS: No tropical development is expected across the Atlantic basin over
the next five days. A weak trough near 55W bears watching early next week
but organization remains unlikely.

ASCAT 10PM Sun14: W DR ENE-ESE@12-16k; E DR ENE-E@8-12k; ABCs E@15-19k

BUOYS: Ponce N-NNE@5-8k; 1'/6secSE / Vieques Sound ENE-E@3g6k

IMAGERY: Scattered squalls along the Windwards this morning, mostly dry
elsewhere across the Leewards and ABCs.

SYNOPSIS:
Moderate E-SE trades persist across the S Windwards and ABCs today-Tue16,
with lighter and more variable wind along the Leewards-VIs as the ridge
axis sits well N of its climatological position.

OUTLOOK:
Trades gradually fill back in across the whole basin by Wed17-Thu18 as the
ridge axis slides south, bringing a more typical easterly pattern through
the rest of the week.

SUGGEST:
Trinidad-StVincent: Fair N bound sailing today-Tue16 with brisk conditions
closest to Trinidad. Travel either direction becomes easier by Wed17.

Antigua-StMartin: Light and variable winds favor motoring today-Tue16,
becoming more sail-friendly by midweek as trades rebuild.

PRECIP (Coverage is highest overnights into mornings):
Trinidad-StVincent: Isolated to 30k today; Scattered to 35k Tue16.

WIND:
*Note that wind driven chop does not reflect swells*.

Trinidad-StVincent: E-SE@12-20g24k/3-5' today; E-SE@14-22g27k/4-6' Tue16.

Antigua-StMartin: Variable up to 10k/0-2' today-Mon15 night; NE-E@8-14g18k/1-3' Tue16.

SWELLS:
Trinidad-Guadeloupe: 3-5'/9-11secNNE today-Tue16.

Antigua-StMartin: 2-4'/9-11secNE today-Tue16.
